taskChanges.newValue: Reproduced three failures: amount=0 with boughtToday=0 falsely showed Free Spin; replaying older userGetInfo restored hasFree; popup trusted a stale hasFree flag despite amount=0. Fixed extraction to use remaining amount, accepted only successful alchemyUseFree responses, preserved boughtToday rather than inventing a value, guarded wheel status by timestamp, and made the popup prefer the newest amount. Countdown now displays HH:MM:SS; after an elapsed reset without a fresh snapshot it shows Check Wheel. Tests: 55 popup/data tests plus 3 wheel RPC tests pass, syntax and git diff checks pass. npm run build bumped 0.9.35 to 0.9.36 and all four version files agree. System Decision Impact: none.
